column1: # Alpine crossing: Hsu's injury, rescue, workers after clearing, Lama Temple visitors and Lamakan gameplay hints.

column3: Should I go back to Xian? I\ncan't be much help standing\nhere, can I?{end_now}

.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}\n.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}\nI{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} am hungry...{end_wait}
Hsu! Can you hear us?{end_wait}

{actor_name:1}! Thank goodness.
We cannot shift
the boulder.{page_break}Can any of you
help us?{end_wait}
Hold on, Hsu!\nWe'll get you free!{end_wait}

I'm stuck between
two boulders.{page_break}At least I wasn't
crushed. Please...
hurry.{end_wait}
We need to lift\none of these rocks.\nBut how?{end_wait}
Hsu is exhausted.\nWe have to hurry.{end_wait}
I have to stay calm.\nFeizhi hates it\nwhen I panic.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, was that you?\nThe boulder moved!{end_wait}
You saved Hsu.\nI know this delayed\nyour journey. Thank you.{end_wait}
Lamakan is dangerous.\nKeep your wits about\nyou out there.{end_wait}
The desert's heat\ncan kill. Look for\nthe oases!{end_wait}
Perhaps meditation\nwill teach me to see\nwhat lies ahead.{end_wait}
I hope Lamakan\nwill be safe to\ncross again someday.{end_wait}

The longer you walk
in Lamakan, the more
your heat will rise.{page_break}If it gets too high,
you will be hurt.{page_break}Find an oasis to
cool down before
you go farther.{end_wait}
I have seen Lamakan\nfrom a distance.\nThat's close enough.{end_wait}
The desert's heat\ntwists even the light.\nIt isn't natural.{end_wait}
If I could see the\nfuture, perhaps I\nwouldn't fear it.{end_wait}
Master Hama worries\nabout your journey\nmore than she says.{end_wait}
Your eyes may fail\nyou out there.\nTrust Reveal.{end_wait}
North: Altin Mine. West:\nLama Temple.{end_wait}
I've been traveling from\nvillage to village. Most\npeople are kinder than{page_break}rumors make them sound.{end_wait}

Those travelers have the
same strange feeling as
Master Hama. It's as if{page_break}someone is looking into my
thoughts.{end_wait}
The rocks are finally out\nof the way. At least\ntravelers can use the road{page_break}again.{end_wait}
People came all the way\nfrom Xian to help clear the\npath. They worked until{page_break}their hands were raw.{end_wait}
The path is open, but there\nare still boulders here. Do\nwe have to move every last{page_break}one?{end_wait}
I nearly threw my back out\nlifting those stones. Next\ntime, I'll train first.{end_wait}
